title: Modal
api:
interface ModalProps {
  trigger?: ReactElement
  title: string
  description?: string
  children?: ReactNode
  footer?: ReactNode
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'full'
  /** Visual presentation; the caller owns confirmation actions and validation. */
  variant?: 'default' | 'confirmation' | 'form' | 'success' | 'danger'
  /** Override the decorative variant icon. Pass null to omit it. */
  icon?: ReactNode
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  open?: boolean
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
  className?: string
  /** Choose the initial target for forms or long content; Base UI keeps its touch-safe default when omitted. */
  initialFocus?: ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof BaseDialog.Popup>['initialFocus']
  /** Restore focus to a stable destination when the opener is removed or the dialog has no trigger. */
  finalFocus?: ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof BaseDialog.Popup>['finalFocus']
}

function Modal({
  trigger,
  title,
  description,
  children,
  footer,
  open,
  defaultOpen,
  size = 'md',
  variant = 'default',
  icon,
  onOpenChange,
  className,
  initialFocus,
  finalFocus,
}: ModalProps);

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual presentation; the caller owns confirmation actions and validation.

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the decorative variant icon. Pass null to omit it.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Choose the initial target for forms or long content; Base UI keeps its touch-safe default when omitted.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description: Restore focus to a stable destination when the opener is removed or the dialog has no trigger.

notes: title is required. Use open/onOpenChange for controlled modals or defaultOpen for an initially open uncontrolled modal.

Variants are default, confirmation, form, success and danger. Sizes are sm, md, lg and full. A variant changes presentation; implement the actual confirmation, submission or deletion in the application.
Retain managed focus, Escape dismissal and focus return. Avoid nesting interactive elements inside the trigger.
